title: Forbidding matching as trace in uniform hypergraphs
summary: We say a hypergraph $\mathcal{H}$ contains a hypergraph $\mathcal{G}$ as trace if there exists a vertex subset $S \subseteq V(\mathcal{H})$ such that $|S| = |V(\mathcal{G})|$ and $\{e \cap S: e \in E(\mathcal{H})\}$ contains $\mathcal{G}$ as a sub-hypergraph. We use $\mathrm{ex}_r(n, \mathrm{Tr}_r(\mathcal{G}))$ to denote the maximum number of hyperedges in an $r$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices not containing $\mathcal{G}$ as a trace.
